title: Earthquake Geotechnics & Geo-Disaster Prevention
description: Research student project in Prof. Hazarika Hemanta's Geo-Disaster Prevention Global Lab, Kyushu University. My focus is geomechanics: how the ground responds to strong shaking, and which geotechnical methods keep roads, slopes and buildings standing. The M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake of 28 July 2026 made this concrete; Prof. Hazarika went into the field to investigate the expressway damage and subsidence. No results yet; this is where I'm starting.
